text: Official Oneleet MCP server: you sign in through a browser, approve what the assistant requests, and pick a workspace, with no keys to create
quote: add the Oneleet MCP server to your assistant, and it opens a browser window where you log in to Oneleet, review what the assistant is asking for, and pick the workspace it should work in.

text: An MCP-connected assistant acts as the signed-in user, is limited to that user's role, and every action is attributed to their account
quote: Once connected, the assistant acts as you. It can only see and do what your own role in the workspace allows, and every action is attributed to your account.

text: Any workspace member can connect an AI assistant without admin involvement, limited by that member's role
quote: Any member can connect — no admin involvement is required — but what the assistant can do is limited by that member’s role.

text: Service keys for agents, MCP servers and scripts are decoupled from user accounts and can be scoped to specific tasks
quote: Use **service keys** for AI agent automation, MCP servers, and scripts to interact with your Oneleet workspace. Service keys are decoupled from user accounts and can be scoped for specific tasks.

text: Service keys can be granted full access to all tenant scopes or limited to selected scopes
quote: Grant Full access to all tenant service-key scopes, or choose Limit access to… to grant only specific scopes.

text: Downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 specs for the Public API (157 paths) and a separate Auditor API (25 paths)
quote: Oneleet serves a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document for its Public API (157 paths) at the API origin, plus a second document for the Auditor API (/api/v1/public/auditor/openapi.json, "Oneleet Auditor API", 25 paths). Scope caveat verbatim

text: API specs can be imported into Postman or used to generate an API client against api.oneleet.com
quote: The docs link the machine specs and consoles directly ("OpenAPI specifications and interactive references:") and note you can import the spec into Postman or use it to generate an API client; both APIs use https://api.oneleet.com as their b

text: Hosted interactive Scalar API references for both the Public and Auditor APIs
quote: Oneleet hosts Scalar-rendered API references for both APIs (the page loads the live OpenAPI document via data-url="./openapi.json"; the Auditor API has its own reference page). The docs call these "interactive references". Caveats: the page

text: API routes are URI-versioned under /api/v1/, with deprecated fields flagged and migration guidance given
quote: Versioning is practiced in the API surface: all routes are URI-versioned under /api/v1/, and the spec carries "deprecated": true members with migration guidance ("Deprecated. Overview of how the risk assessment was personalized, retained fo

text: Code security findings can be triaged, assigned and resolved on the platform
quote: The results become findings you can triage, assign, and resolve on the platform, with a CI check that keeps new issues out of your pull requests.

text: A CI check blocks new code security issues from entering pull requests
quote: with a CI check that keeps new issues out of your pull requests

text: Code Security provides static analysis (SAST) and secrets detection
quote: Oneleet Code Security is static analysis (SAST) and secrets detection for the code you write.

text: Repositories' target branches are scanned daily, and manual scans can be started at any time
quote: Oneleet scans the target branch of each repository once a day, and you can start a scan manually at any time with New scan.

text: Application Security runs DAST against live web apps, crawling them and exercising their inputs and forms like an attacker would
quote: Oneleet Application Security uses Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) to evaluate your running web applications by testing them from the outside in, much like an attacker would.

text: DAST logs in first so it can test the authenticated attack surface of an application
quote: When an application requires a login, Oneleet Application Security authenticates first, so it tests the authenticated attack surface of the application

text: Monitors AWS accounts, RDS instances, application and classic load balancers, and IAM users
quote: Oneleet currently monitors the following AWS resources: Accounts, RDS instances, Application and Classic load balancers, IAM users

text: AWS access works through an AssumeRole role, and access is revoked by deleting that role
quote: Oneleet uses the AWS AssumeRole API to work with AWS resources — if you'd like to remove Oneleet's access to your workspace, simply delete the created role

text: AWS resources tagged oneleet-ignore=true are excluded from ingestion
quote: You can prevent AWS resources from being read into Oneleet by adding the tag `oneleet-ignore=true` for resources which support tagging.

text: GitHub integration monitors configuration, user access and Dependabot vulnerabilities without needing access to repository contents
quote: This integration supports Cloud Security monitoring for GitHub. You can use it to monitor your GitHub configuration, user access, and Dependabot vulnerabilities. It does not require access to repository contents.

text: Google Workspace integration monitors user accounts and Gmail settings
quote: Oneleet currently monitors the following on Google Workspace: User accounts, GMail settings

text: Hundreds of monitors watch the stack for gaps in real time
quote: Hundreds of monitors watch your stack for gaps in real time.

text: Role-based access control with custom organization roles that have precise permissions and can be assigned to members
quote: with RBAC you can also create your own organization roles with a precise set of permissions and assign them to members.

text: Built-in MDM lets admins verify devices are managed, view their security posture, enforce settings, and take remote action on lost or offboarded devices
quote: Admins can confirm that devices are managed, see each device’s security posture, enforce security settings, and take remote action when a device is lost, stolen, or being offboarded.

text: A recommended secure baseline for macOS and Windows can be applied in one click as the org-wide device policy
quote: Oneleet offers a recommended secure baseline for macOS and Windows that can be applied in one click. Applying the secure defaults pre-fills settings as your organization-wide device policy - nothing is locked in.

text: Macs enroll through Apple MDM, either manually or zero-touch via Automated Device Enrollment
quote: Macs enroll through Apple's Mobile Device Management framework, either manually or zero-touch through Automated Device Enrollment

text: Linux workstations are managed through the Oneleet Agent, with security checks and remote actions across major distributions
quote: Linux workstations are managed through the Oneleet Agent as well, with security checks and remote actions across major distributions.

text: Policy templates come in two tiers, Formal (minimum viable) and Comprehensive, and can be customized
quote: Formal (Minimum Viable Policies): These templates cover essential security guidelines. Comprehensive: These are more detailed policies that include stricter requirements

text: Draft policies that don't require review can be published in bulk from the Policies page
quote: On the **Policies** page, choose **Publish draft policies** to publish drafts that don’t require review.

text: A control mapped once counts toward every framework
quote: Map a control once and it counts for every framework.

text: Removing a framework drops its unused auto-added controls but keeps controls that other frameworks share or that contain work
quote: Removing a framework also removes unused controls that were automatically added for it. Controls stay when another framework requires them or when they contain work such as evidence, review history, assignments, or custom content.

text: Re-adding a framework restores its missing default controls
quote: Adding the framework again restores its missing default controls.

text: Supports SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR and other frameworks on one platform
quote: Whether you need SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, or another framework. Oneleet's all-in-one platform simplifies your compliance journey.

text: Fieldwork AI agents collect, validate and package evidence across enterprise systems on a schedule, based on a described control
quote: Describe your control. Fieldwork’s AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence – across your enterprise systems, on your schedule.

text: Fieldwork pulls evidence from connectors using both APIs and browser workflows
quote: Fieldwork uses APIs and browser workflows to access evidence from your connectors.

text: Continuously maps external infrastructure, identifies risks and generates SOC 2 evidence
quote: Oneleet maps your external infrastructure, identifies risks, and generates SOC 2 evidence, continuously.

text: Risks can be scored and linked to the controls that address them
quote: Score what could go wrong and connect it to the controls that answer it.

text: A customizable Trust Center can be set up, published, and linked from your landing page
quote: Once onboarded to the Oneleet platform, set up and publish your customizable Trust Center. You can add a link to the Trust Center on your Landing Page

text: Includes a human-led penetration test that feeds directly into the audit
quote: Drata makes you hire a pentest firm for $5k to $15k. Oneleet includes a human-led one, straight into your audit.

text: Provides engineers who fix pentest findings, plus a vCISO
quote: Oneleet gives you the actual security: a real pentest, engineers who fix what it finds, and a vCISO.

text: A dedicated vCISO builds your SOC 2 program and helps you pass security reviews
quote: Leverage Oneleet as your security team with a dedicated vCISO to create your SOC 2 program & help you pass security reviews.

text: Single flat price with everything included, with no per-framework or implementation fees
quote: Drata adds implementation costs of about $10k to $25k, per-framework fees, and renewal hikes. Oneleet is one price, everything included.

text: Email notifications whenever an incident is created, updated or resolved
quote: Get email notifications whenever Oneleet creates, updates or resolves an incident.

text: Guides for setting up Oneleet security modules and hardening your existing setup
quote: Here you’ll find guides on how to set up Oneleet’s security modules as well as guides for hardening your existing setup.
